title: TECHball web
subtitle: A local analysis interface for Football Manager data
description: A local web application for searching and filtering Football Manager player data, evaluating players on a tactics board, and exploring them with Scout AI.
detailDescription: TECHball is a local player scouting prototype that brings candidate discovery, comparison, and squad building into one workspace. It makes searches using filters or natural-language questions easier to explore through data-based results.

cover.alt: TECHball player list, filters, and tactics board

gallery.alt: TECHball Scout AI response and player query results

title: yatatodo
subtitle: A personal task list with daily planning
description: A React application combining task creation, editing, filtering, and prioritization with a Gemini Flash-powered daily planning flow.
detailDescription: Yatatodo is a personal task application that goes beyond recording to-dos to help you decide how to allocate the day’s limited time. Gemini Flash planning suggests an order and duration while leaving the final decision to the user.

cover.alt: yatatodo task list, priorities, and generated daily plan

title: YataQuizing
subtitle: A timed quiz experience powered by JSON files
description: A web application that starts quizzes from user-uploaded JSON questions, with a timer, progress, answer tracking, and explained results.

cover.alt: YataQuizing quiz selection and JSON file upload screen

gallery.alt: YataQuizing timed question screen and answer choices

title: YataClimate
subtitle: Live weather and a seven-day forecast
description: A weather application combining city search, current conditions, an hourly view, and a seven-day forecast.
detailDescription: YataClimate brings current weather and forecasts for different cities together in readable cards and city detail views. It combines temperature with hourly changes, precipitation, wind, and a weekly outlook to make daily planning easier.

cover.alt: YataClimate city cards and current weather summaries

gallery.alt: YataClimate weather and hourly forecast for Bursa

title: Yata Market
subtitle: An e-commerce demo with a product catalog and cart
description: A full-stack application combining product search, category and price filters, favorites, a persistent cart, and demo product management with an Express API.
detailDescription: Yata Market is an e-commerce demo covering the basic shopping journey from product discovery to the cart. The catalog, product details, favorites, cart, and demo product management share a React interface and Express API.

cover.alt: Yata Market product catalog, search, and filter controls

gallery.alt: Yata Market cart, product quantities, and order summary

title: Personal Library
subtitle: Books, authors, and a reading journal backend
description: A local learning application with a React interface for managing authors and books, and an Express API for book-related notes and quotations.
detailDescription: Personal Library is a local learning application for organizing author and book records. It separates the responsibilities of two data models: relational catalog data in PostgreSQL and the API backend for book-related notes and quotations in MongoDB.

cover.alt: Personal Library book list, search, and reading status filter

gallery.alt: Personal Library author list and author editing form

title: YataOil
subtitle: A vehicle listing and fuel cost research flow
description: A research prototype combining brand and listing searches with vehicle details and a fuel cost screen.
detailDescription: YataOil aims to evaluate used-car listings and running costs in one flow. Listing and fuel cost screens are available; the scope of live external service integrations still needs verification.

gallery.alt: YataOil vehicle details and fuel cost calculation
